summary: Opened a new sourced lead in the follower's log-conflict path and recorded its mechanism: the AppendEntries handler deletes a conflicting suffix, then returns on a store error before setLastLog, so the in-memory last log keeps naming entries the store no longer holds, while the leader's replication loop counts the RPC error as a failed contact and retries with an unchanged nextIndex, so only the SEND_SNAP path or a restart can repair it. Added five source anchors (raft.go 1561-1583, state.go 105-110, replication.go 222-226, 229-235, 255-263), one behavior knowledge entry covering which paths do and do not advance the last log and nextIndex, a new investigation (@append_store_failure), and its interpretation with conclusion conditional and defect_claim unresolved. Validation returned valid with those effects and no execution requested; the incomplete work is the measurement itself, since nothing wrapped a log store to fail inside that window, and the trigger stays a supplied single store error.
